description: This file defines the 'TypeConverter' class, which handles formatting and parsing of Type instances within Orleans.Serialization. It manages type name conversions, filters, serializers, and alias resolution, integral to the serialization process in Orleans.

classes.name: TypeConverter
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the formatting and parsing of Type instances, handling type name filters, aliases, and serialization constraints in Orleans.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats a Type into a string representation, optionally applying a rewriter delegate.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string type name into a Type, throwing an exception if parsing or type loading fails.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempt to parse a string type name into a Type, returning a boolean indicating success.

methods.name: FormatInternal
methods.description: Internal method to format a Type, handling type conversion and rewriting.

methods.name: ParseInternal
methods.description: Internal method to parse a string or TypeSpec into a Type, applying validation and filters.
